text: DSH Steam Startup Animation 是一款面向 DeepSeek Harness 的开屏动画插件，通过客户端扩展位在应用启动时显示约六秒的全屏 Canvas 动画：终端工作站逐步绘制、变形成圆环，再显现 DeepSeek 鲸鱼标志和字样。动画结束后露出实际应用界面，也可由用户按 Esc 或点击跳过。插件提供启动播放开关、可选音效、音量调节和预览，并能根据桌面端、减少动态效果等偏好决定是否自动播放。适合希望定制 DSH 启动视觉效果的桌面用户；需要兼容的 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x 版本，不需要额外密钥。

DSH Steam Startup Animation adds a six-second DeepSeek Harness Desktop splash: a terminal scene morphs into the whale mark. Users can skip it, set startup playback and audio, adjust volume, or preview. Playback respects desktop and reduced-motion preferences. Requires a compatible DSH 0.2.x host.
想给 DSH 桌面端加一个有动画和鲸鱼标志的开屏。
能不能让启动画面播放音效，还可以调音量或跳过？
I want a short animated splash screen when my DSH desktop app starts.
DSH Steam Startup Animation 的功能「启动开屏」：应用启动时显示约六秒动画，终端工作站逐步变形成圆环并显现鲸鱼标志；动画结束后露出应用，用户也可按 Esc 或点击按钮提前跳过。
DSH Steam Startup Animation 的功能「播放设置与预览」：在插件配置页切换启动播放和音效、调节音量或播放预览；偏好保存在当前浏览器本地存储，并可限制为桌面端自动播放。

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Install in Desktop：Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.3 or later in the 0.2.x line**.

1. Download `dsh-startup-animation.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation/releases/latest).
2. Open Desktop's **Plugins** page, choose **Add plugin**, and enter the local tarball path (or its release download URL).
3. Enable the plugin and reload the application when requested.

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Install in Desktop：Install through Desktop's plugin manager so it targets Desktop's own profile. A separate `web` profile does not change the Desktop application.

For a regular web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation/releases/latest/download/dsh-startup-animation.tgz
```

Automatic playback is desktop-only by default; enable web playback on the plugin's page if wanted.

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Controls：Open the plugin's own detail page to enable startup playback, switch audio, set volume, allow web playback, or play a preview. Preferences are stored locally in the current application's browser storage and take effect at the next startup or preview.

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Controls：- **Esc** or **Skip** dismisses the animation immediately.
- System **reduced motion** skips automatic playback.
- A browser that blocks automatic sound shows **Enable sound**. The animation continues and ends on time.
- Switching tasks or changing plugin configuration does not replay the opening. Reloading the application starts a new opening.
- The final background darkens with the whale, then reveals the running application. No mock application is included.

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Controls：The plugin does not read conversation content or credentials, make network requests, modify host code, or add install-time scripts. Audio, artwork and light-field data are packaged in the client. Disabling/unloading it stops audio, cancels animation frames, removes observers/listeners, restores focus and releases the overlay.

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Controls：The Canvas renderer runs in a dedicated OffscreenCanvas worker, so Harness startup tasks can load while the artwork continues drawing. A compositor animation handles the final fade. Browsers without worker rendering use the same artwork through a main-thread fallback.

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Development：The source checkout includes the prebuilt `lib/` files and needs no install-time compilation. Rebuild with Node.js 22+:

```sh
npm run check
npm pack
```

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Development：With Playwright available, `tests/browser.cjs` checks the fallback lifecycle, `tests/worker-lifecycle.cjs` checks worker completion and recovery, and `tests/startup-contention.cjs` verifies that a 180 ms host task does not freeze the startup. `DSH_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE` can point to an existing Playwright installation. `scripts/build.mjs` uses only Node built-ins; React and Cordis slots come from the running host. The plugin registers `plugins.bundle.config` through the public slots API.

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · Credits and license：Plugin code is MIT licensed. DeepSeek branding and Valve's Steam startup audio remain their owners' material and are excluded from the code license. See [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

This is an independent community plugin, unaffiliated with DeepSeek or Valve.

section: DSH Steam 风格开屏动画

text:
@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · 桌面端安装：需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.3 或更新的 0.2.x 版本**。

1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-startup-animation.tgz`。
2. 打开桌面端的**插件管理 → 添加插件**，输入本地压缩包路径，或 Release 下载地址。
3. 启用插件；宿主提示需要刷新时，重新加载应用。

请通过桌面端自己的插件管理器安装，确保进入桌面端的 profile。单独安装到 `web` profile 不会影响桌面端。

普通 Web profile 也可安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation/releases/latest/download/dsh-startup-animation.tgz
```
@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · 桌面端安装：默认仅桌面端自动播放；可在插件页面开启 Web 自动播放。

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · 使用：打开插件详情页，可设置启动时播放、音效、音量、仅桌面端播放，并随时播放预览。设置保存在当前应用的浏览器本地存储中，对下一次启动或预览生效。

- 点击**跳过**或按 **Esc** 立即结束。
- 系统开启**减少动态效果**时，跳过自动播放。
- 浏览器阻止自动播放声音时，会出现**开启声音**按钮；动画仍按时结束。
- 切换任务和热加载不会反复播放；重新加载应用会开始新一轮开屏。
- 鲸鱼消失时背景同步变暗，随后露出真实应用界面。

插件不读取对话或凭据，不请求网络，不修改宿主源码，也没有安装期脚本。动画、光场和音效都随插件打包。禁用或卸载时会停止音频、取消动画帧、释放观察器和事件监听、移除遮罩并恢复焦点。

动画通过独立的 OffscreenCanvas 工作线程绘制，Harness 启动任务加载时仍能继续播放；最后的淡出由合成动画完成。不支持工作线程绘制的浏览器会使用相同画面的兼容路径。

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · 开发：仓库已包含构建后的 `lib/`，从源码安装无需运行构建脚本。Node.js 22+ 可重新构建：

```sh
npm run check
npm pack
```

安装 Playwright 后，`tests/browser.cjs` 验证兼容路径，`tests/worker-lifecycle.cjs` 验证工作线程的播放和回收，`tests/startup-contention.cjs` 验证界面线程忙 180 毫秒时动画继续播放。可用 `DSH_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE` 指向已有的 Playwright 安装。`scripts/build.mjs` 仅使用 Node 内置模块。React 与 Cordis slots 由宿主提供，配置页通过公开的 `plugins.bundle.config` 扩展位注册。

@bilbillm/dsh-startup-animation README · 署名与许可：插件代码使用 MIT 许可证。DeepSeek 品牌标记与 Valve 的 Steam 启动音频归各自权利人所有，不属于代码的 MIT 授权范围，详见[第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

本插件为独立社区项目，与 DeepSeek、Valve 无隶属关系。
